name: Southern Championships 2017

venue.name: [Westin Galleria Houston](https://www.starwoodhotels.com/westin/property/overview/index.html?propertyID=1053)
venue.details: The venue will be held in both Woodway II and Woodway III room's on the Fourth Level.

information: This competition will have a 300 person competitor limit. Registration opens June 3rd. Competitors must register online by July 8th and pay online in order to reserve their spot in the competition. Residents of Texas, Oklahoma, New Mexico, Lousiana, Arkansas, Mississippi, and Alabama are also eligible to win the title of Southern Champion.
